title: Vibe Coded an IDLE RPG
author: Com4dor
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/ii150wzuivyg1.jpg?width=1919&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=f787cee60d0d75233e88f49425a97fe98b274cae

Been building my own game, Runeswick ... a dark fantasy idle RPG with offline progress, skilling, crafting, combat, dungeons.   
  
It’s heavily inspired by the kind of progression systems I’ve always liked (RuneScape/idle RPG style), but I’m building it my own way with a focus on queue-based progression, meaningful grind, and constant updates.   
  
I used Chatgpt to build Prompts based on my ideas of the game, any issues, new features ect. Then I took those prompts and put them into Cursor to allow cursor to build the game for me. That being said tho i do have knowledge in Programming and have programmed a few odd games myself and thought i'd give Vibe programming a go! Its definitely not as easy as everyone makes vibe coding out to be with all the challenges you face building a game. Having background experience in developing games & programming definitely makes this a lot easier.  
  
Still early, still growing, but it’s fully playable right now and I’m actively improving it almost daily based on player feedback.   
  
Would love to hear what you think: [https://runeswick.com/](https://runeswick.com/)   
  
Always open to feedback!
